_how_to: One row per consolidated commitment (12). authorisation = standard_authorised | exception_approved | no_approval_evidence | unknown_needs_review, or null for exploratory/conditional commitments (null means not applicable). authorisation_evidence cites the catalogue path and the AR-05 pricing-note row. contractual_presence = absent | included_in_draft_contract (following SOW No. 1 and Annex 1, incorporated by contract clause 3). issues use overcommitment | expectation_gap | contradiction | needs_review. reason = absolute_limit where the item is not in the catalogue at all, else null. customer_context items are {type: reliance | customer_obligation, source_id, quote}.
